summary: Phase 81.80 — Dynamic Content Configuration system fully tested. Backend: 20/20 tests pass. Frontend: Content Config tab visible, 3 section editors work, save/reset/preview toggle functional, variable chips work. Public consent screen renders dynamic content with variable substitution.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Backend: content_config_routes.py correctly implements GET/PUT/POST reset for all 3 section types
✅ Backend: Public endpoint /api/docflow/public/content-config returns defaults when no tenant resolved (is_default_only=true)
✅ Backend: Auth endpoints return 403 without token, 400 for invalid section types
✅ Backend: PUT with empty content returns 400 as expected
✅ Frontend: ContentConfigPage.js has 3 section editors with live preview
✅ Frontend: Variable chips (7 total) insert tokens at cursor position
✅ Frontend: Save persists to backend, Reset restores defaults
✅ Frontend: ConsentScreen.js fetches public content config and renders with variable substitution
✅ Frontend: contentVariables.js correctly substitutes {{var}} placeholders with fallbacks
FIXED: Nested button HTML issue in ConsentDisclosureEditor (button inside button) - changed outer button to div
seed_data_creation: None - used existing package run ba180c77-b87f-4581-b969-f10f6e7160ec for public endpoint testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 81.80 Dynamic Content Configuration fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: GET/PUT/POST /api/docflow/content-config/{section_type}, GET /api/docflow/public/content-config. Section types: consent_disclosure, review_continue, sms_disclaimer. Frontend tab: Content Config in DocFlow Dashboard. Variable substitution: {{user_name}}, {{email}}, {{phone}}, {{phone_last4}}, {{company_name}}, {{document_name}}, {{date}}.
